name: Inaba Chitose
source:
Chitose is [url=https://vndb.org/c12870]Hiroshi[/url]'s younger sister. She is very courageous and always puts others before herself. Since she is suffering from a serious heart defect, she can't even get out of her bed, but she is truly happy to hear that her brother returned to the village after such a long time. She can't make new friends because of her condition and so that's why she cherishes every moment that she can spend with her dearest brother and sister that are visiting her often. She will take a special liking to Oujo's stuffed cat-like doll, Archimedes.

Hobbies: Reading shoujo manga, playing girly games (ayatori, shiritori, etc.)
Favorites: [url=https://vndb.org/c12870]Onii-chan[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c12876]Onee-chan[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c3129]Ojou-chan[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c3370]Archimedes[/url]...-chan?
Basic Behavior: Although she is suffering from a heart defection and is unable to leave her bed without significant aid, that doesn't stop her from being brave enough to fight her disease. She also cares dearly for people close to her more than she cares about herself.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=43]MangaGamer[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/922090-suika-as/faqs/58095]neo-X-saga's Walkthrough[/url]]
